newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Golden Vale H1 pre-tax profit falls 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Golden Vale H1 pre-tax profit falls 49 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Irish-based food company Golden Vale Plc said the significant factor affecting the results was an imbalance between weak primary dairy markets and the price paid for milk supplies.
It said the dominant influence on the second half of the year was likely to be the continuing weak market conditions prevailing for primary dairy products.
Full-year profits would also be affected by a severence package for former managing director Jim O'Mahony and any charges arising from superlevy arrears, Golden Vale said.

NOTE - Golden Vale said a net provision of up to three million punts would be required in the full year accounts to cover the exceptional charges arising from the severence package and superlevy arrears.
